brief: 6 tools I use to ship mobile apps as a solo web developer — no native knowledge required.

slots.tagline: Design pixel-perfect mobile interfaces and component libraries that developers build directly from.
slots.f1Body: Build responsive components that scale across screen sizes instantly.
slots.f2Body: Keep colors, type, and assets synced across every project file.
slots.f3Body: Export CSS values and measurements without any guesswork.

slots.tagline: Write, refactor, and debug full-stack mobile features with an AI pair programmer inside your IDE.
slots.f1Body: Accept entire functions and component blocks in a single keystroke.
slots.f2Body: Ask questions about your codebase and get file-aware answers instantly.
slots.f3Body: Rename variables, extract components, and clean syntax automatically.

slots.tagline: Ship server-rendered web apps that feel native on mobile browsers and install like apps.
slots.f1Body: Stream data and code to devices with zero client-side bloat.
slots.f2Body: Run backend logic without managing a separate server layer.
slots.f3Body: Add offline support and home-screen installability in minutes.

slots.tagline: Replace Firebase with an open-source Postgres stack handling auth, storage, and real-time data.
slots.f1Body: Add magic-link and social login with a few lines of code.
slots.f2Body: Query relational data with full SQL power and row-level security.
slots.f3Body: Push live updates to every connected mobile client automatically.

slots.tagline: Collect subscriptions and one-time purchases inside your app with pre-built mobile-ready components.
slots.f1Body: Redirect users to a branded payment page that converts.
slots.f2Body: Sync payment status to your database in real time securely.
slots.f3Body: Manage trials, invoicing, and recurring revenue without extra code.

slots.tagline: Deploy every push to a global edge network and preview changes before they reach users.
slots.f1Body: Ship production updates with every commit automatically.
slots.f2Body: Share branch previews with stakeholders for instant visual feedback.
slots.f3Body: Run serverless logic close to users for sub-second API responses.

slots.ctaBody: No native teams required. This web stack ships mobile experiences that feel native and convert fast.
